headline: Exchange Outflow Widened To $459 Million From $256 Million
narrative: Exchanges sent out $459 million across assets in the latest day, 0.1698 percent of custodied value, wider than a $256 million outflow. The exchange pipe measures dollars across all assets on trading venues, and a negative print means that value left the places where holders can sell. Poloniex accounted for $297 million of the outflow, the largest single venue, while Binance took in $131 million.
author: jordan
